scope: Commit Continue request settings with its exact prepared launch and expected-slot CAS; remove save-before-run and rollback so rejected or losing callers cannot overwrite another launch.
architecture: Continue carries four explicit request settings from editor and MCP into payload construction before voice validation and provider preparation.
The launch compare-and-swap updates the four settings, slot, processing state and cleared error with the prepared launch and activities in one D1 batch.

Stop-at changes retain the existing settings history shape and summary; INSERT SELECT reads the actual previous stop under the same expected-slot predicate before update. Settings event IDs precede start event IDs.
CAS refusal leaves all settings and activities untouched; SQL failures roll back the batch. Pending receipts retain only state that the batch actually committed.
No settings revision token, new table, column, migration or platform-domain exception is added.
remainingActions: Cancellation and full content/descendant event ownership remain open.
External event/email retry atomicity, standalone AnalyzeScript CLI and independent Update all preflight remain open.
Legacy raw claims without a durable launch record cannot recover a missing payload.
Deployed multi-instance Cloudflare, browser/provider and settlement acceptance remain unverified.

Internal ordinary sequence.update still accepts these fields and the workflow start step still repeats generationStopAt under its owner guard; this batch does not define a separate settings-edit invalidation protocol.
A separate existing create path accepts draftMotion but omits it from sequenceData; handle separately instead of expanding this concurrency batch.

scope: Expected-slot and organization predicates are identical for settings event and mutation.
SQL failures and uncertain receipts cannot invoke a settings rollback.
Settings history JSON and event-ID order preserve the prior activity contract.
Payload overlay precedes voice validation; explicit false values and derived stop flags share one request record.
Non-Continue branches and unrelated ordinary edits retain their prior behavior.
additionalTestsIncluded: Continue committed-claim receipt loss with an actual settings event.
remainingSuggestedTests: Explicit unrelated title/model edits during delayed preparation; existing scoped update predicates were reviewed, but this specific interleaving is not claimed as tested.

assertionChanges.note: Removed the obsolete wrapper save/rollback call-count cases; the new real scoped-D1 file covers their behavior and concurrency. Existing architecture assertions, timeouts and inventory counts are unchanged.
